name: skylark_check_flight_status
intent: Check the status of a SkyLark flight
description: Opens SkyLark flight status, searches by flight number, and returns the flight status summary shown for that flight.
patterns: What's the status of my flight?

steps.intent: Tap Flight status to open the flight status lookup
Type {{flight_number}} into the Flight number field
Tap Search to look up the flight status

outputs.name: flight_status_summary
outputs.example: SL 1190 · ATL → DEN · Sat, Nov 14, 2026 · Delayed 25 min · Gate A7 · Departs 2:45 PM
